reviewedBy: Dr. K. M. Rahman (Poultry Disease Specialist, DVM, MS)
disclaimer: Sonali birds require strict early brooding warmth and proactive coccidiosis management on floor litter. Consult a licensed veterinarian.

stages.name: Early Brooding
tips: Sonali chicks are more temperature-sensitive than commercial broilers during the first week.
Ensure round brooding hover hovers provide even 34°C floor warmth.
Supply electrolyte water and cracked maize/mash on chick paper.
Monitor chick spread: huddling indicates cold, panting against walls indicates overheating.

milestones.title: Newcastle Disease (ND Baby Chick / Clone 30) Eye-drop
milestones.instructions: Administer 1 eye-drop per chick with dedicated dropper. Hold chick until drop is absorbed.

milestones.title: Infectious Bursal Disease (Gumboro Intermediate) Eye-drop
milestones.instructions: Administer 1 drop in eye. Keep cold-chain ice box next to handler at all times.

stages.name: Late Brooding & Starter
tips: Reduce supplemental brooding heat as feathered cover develops.
Increase floor area by expanding pen barriers gradually.
Rake litter twice weekly to maintain friable, dry bedding.

milestones.title: Fowl Pox Wing-Web Puncture Vaccination
milestones.instructions: Dip the double-needle applicator into reconstituted Fowl Pox vaccine and pierce the clean wing-web membrane. Avoid blood vessels and muscles.

milestones.title: Gumboro (IBD) Drinking Water Booster
milestones.instructions: Deprive birds of water for 2 hours beforehand. Dissolve vaccine with non-fat milk powder in clean water.

milestones.title: Day 21 Flock Weighing & Transition Review
milestones.instructions: Weigh 5% of birds (target: 200-240g). Evaluate uniformity and check plumage development.

stages.name: Growing Phase
stages.feed: Sonali Grower Pellets / Mash (18-19% crude protein)
tips: Provide perches or natural roosting slats to satisfy indigenous natural behavior.
Perform routine deworming around Day 35 to prevent Ascaridia / roundworm burden.
Ensure sufficient feeder space: at least 3-4 cm feeder edge per bird.

milestones.title: Newcastle Disease (ND LaSota) Drinking Water Booster
milestones.instructions: Administer live ND LaSota booster in morning drinking water. Ensure all water lines are pre-cleaned.

milestones.title: Routine Flock Deworming Treatment
milestones.instructions: Administer approved broad-spectrum poultry anthelmintic (e.g. Levamisole or Piperazine) in drinking water according to flock body weight.

milestones.title: Day 42 Mid-Cycle Weighing Benchmark
milestones.instructions: Sample 50 birds across pen areas (target: 480-550g). Record weight uniformity percentage.

stages.name: Finishing Phase
tips: Optimize yellow skin / shanks pigmentation if demanded by premium local market via natural maize or marigold extracts.
Ensure good ventilation to maintain dry litter and prevent breast blisters.
Check withdrawal times for any recent medications before sale.

milestones.title: Day 56 Pre-Market Weight Sampling
milestones.instructions: Weigh representative birds (target: 700-800g). Gauge market readiness.

milestones.title: Final Market Harvest Weighing & Batch Close
milestones.instructions: Target live weight: 850-1000g. Record total sold birds, final average weight, and gross revenue.
